title: ioctl_do_agree: salt and info not zeroized on stack after use
description: ioctl_do_agree() places derived key material in op.okm[] on the stack struct. On success and failure, memzero_explicit(op.okm) is called. But the salt[] and info[] fields in the same stack struct are not zeroized. salt and info may contain sensitive protocol context (e.g. session keys, identity material). FIPS 140-3 requires memzero_explicit before releasing memory. A stack frame is released by pointer adjustment, not zeroing, so salt/info bytes persist in the stack until overwritten. Same issue applies to digest[] in ioctl_do_sign and ioctl_do_verify. Trigger: DO_AGREE with non-zero salt/info → function returns → salt/info bytes remain in kernel stack until next function uses that frame.
close_reason: fixed: converted ioctl_do_agree to goto out_zero pattern; memzero_explicit(&op, sizeof(op)) covers all paths including salt[] and info[]
